reason: Pay-when-happy is clever, I'll give him that, but I've been left with a half-finished site before and the money wasn't the worst of it, it was months of chasing. A one-man outfit in Kuwait with no UK clients, made-up demo sites and nobody in my Facebook group vouching for him isn't someone I'll hand my business's front door to.
objection: If he goes quiet halfway through or the time difference drags it out, I've lost weeks again and there's nobody local to hold to account. And at £655 for a business my size I'd wonder what corners are being cut.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of UK business owners I can actually ring, or someone in my local group recommending him after he's delivered for them.
